Scheduling a meeting over text shouldn't take five messages.

Smart Scheduling offers your team's open times right in the thread, books the slot on the right calendar, and sends the reminders for you.
Book meetings without leaving the text thread. Smart Scheduling offers open times, syncs calendars and sends reminders automatically.
Meetings, booked in the conversation 📅 Tap a time, get the invite, get reminded. Smart Scheduling is live — link in bio. #scheduling #smallbusiness
